description: This file defines the MockHandler class used in AWS SDK for PHP to simulate responses for testing purposes. It manages a queue of result or exception objects to emulate AWS service interactions.

classes.name: MockHandler
classes.description: A mock handler for AWS SDK in PHP that simulates responses using a queue of results and exceptions, facilitating testing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MockHandler with an optional initial queue of results or exceptions and optional callbacks for fulfilled and rejected promises.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds one or more ResultInterface objects, exceptions, or callables to the handler's queue.

methods.name: appendException
methods.description: Adds one or more Exception or Throwable objects to the queue.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles a command and request, returning a Promise that resolves or rejects based on the queued items.

methods.name: getLastRequest
methods.description: Returns the last request received by the handler.

methods.name: getLastCommand
methods.description: Returns the last command sent to the handler.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of remaining items in the queue.
